caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular object resembling a lantern or container, constructed from both wood and metal elements. The top and bottom surfaces are composed of wood, shown in brown hues, and the object is supported at the corners by four turned wooden posts in matching color. The sides of the container are formed from metallic panels with a grayish-silver color, featuring rows of perforated holes arranged in circular and spiral patterns. The front metal panel has a small latch or handle. The top surface contains three inset metal panels held within a wooden frame, each similarly perforated. A thin, curved wire handle, colored gray to suggest metal, is attached to the top via two small hooked fixtures. The background is a plain off-white or light beige, with no additional objects or scenery present.
title: Foot Warmer
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
